plot_review: Enormous variable scatter reaches order-unity flux changes, including negative normalized residuals near minus one and positive excursions above one. The narrow selected box is not a credible isolated shallow transit. Secondary scan also selects a large nearby dip and brightening; physical interpretation is unreliable without data/source diagnostics.
host_attribution: Weak target-region residuals and background offset do not establish isolated source for enormous QLP excursions; physical interpretation unreliable.
